clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says there's a four-step ladder behind every unmet goal, and most people get stuck on step one.

Say "I want control" - it rings hollow. Say "I need control" - still hollow. Say "I have control" - neutral, but now you're gripping something you're afraid to lose.

The real level above all of them: "I don't care if I have control." That's the one that actually resonates as true.

The same ladder works for safety, for love, for approval - anything you're chasing too hard.

Which one are you stuck on?

#kevintrudeau #mindset #lettinggo #manifesting #selfimprovement #innerpeace

clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau learned this from Herb Cohen, the negotiation expert behind "You Can Negotiate Anybody."

Cohen loved cigars so much he negotiated the right to smoke one while teaching a seminar - in a non-smoking hotel room. His own rule for getting what he wanted: "You have to care, but not that much."

Kevin Trudeau says that's the whole secret to happiness too. Want things. Work for things. Just don't let your peace depend on getting them.

Care enough to try. Not enough to suffer.

#kevintrudeau #mindset #lettinggo #negotiation #selfimprovement #innerpeace

Kevin Trudeau tells this story from an old episode of Father Knows Best.

A father comes downstairs thrilled - his wife promised fresh blueberry muffins from the new bakery, and he'd been thinking about them all night. She forgot. Her face drops, waiting for him to be upset.

He just shrugs: "I'm not going to let the absence of blueberry muffins ruin my morning. What else are we going to have for breakfast?"

Kevin Trudeau remembers yelling at his own dad to watch that show - because his father was nothing like that man.

What's your "blueberry muffins" moment?
